# S10 scenario catalogue (generated by tools/s10_scenario_catalogue.py; do not edit)

104 distinct integration scenarios (S10-SC-*, S10-MCP-*, S10-XCH-*), plus 16 operational ids. Every scenario is synthetic and offline. A positive (released) path and its negative counterparts are separate tests, so a deny-everything implementation fails.
